newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hijacker says he has bomb, more passengers freed.
newsitem.headline: Hijacker says he has bomb, more passengers freed.

text.p: A lone hijacker of an Air Malta airliner to Germany on a flight from Valletta to Istanbul on Monday has told police he has a bomb, a police spokesman said.

"The assailant says he has got a bomb with him. We are still negoatiating with him," Cologne police spokesman Werner Schmidt told reporters at Cologne-Bonn airport, where the plane was standing at the freight section.
Police said earlier that five of the passengers, including an elderly woman with heart problems, had left the plane.
Police have established contact with the lone hijacker and said he had demanded a Turkish-speaking interpreter, indicating he was from Turkey or at least Turkish-speaking.
According to Air Malta, the airliner had 74 passengers and six prew on board when it took off from Malta. It landed at Cologne-Bonn airport at 4.47 a.m. (0247 GMT).
